sections.title: Gustar + Infinitivo
sections.content:
When talking about activities you like doing, use **gusta** (singular) followed directly by the infinitive verb:
- *Me gusta viajar* (I like to travel / I like traveling)
- *No me gusta cocinar* (I don't like to cook)

items.english: What do you like to do?

items.spanish: Me gusta leer y escuchar música.
items.english: I like to read and listen to music.

sections.content: Even if you list multiple verbs, *gusta* stays singular: *Me gusta cantar y bailar*.
